words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer withdraws the event with the status set to “withdrawn”, with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_…”.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals withdrawn.
As the buyer, list the event's line items and check that Data check: “status” equals open; Data check: “quantity” equals 40.
As the buyer, read the event's history and check that Data check: “event withdrawn reopened” has exactly 1 entries; Schema check: “event ref” is present; Data check: “quantity” equals 40.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals withdrawn; Data check: “status” equals open; Data check: “quantity” equals 40; Data check: “event withdrawn reopened” has exactly 1 entries; Schema check: “event ref” is present; Data check: “quantity” equals 40.
